reason: Retain Raft safety and decision contracts. Migrate single-configuration observers to joint configurations and V2 entries; change only contracts supported by the new API/tests; add missing lifecycle, copy, restoration, and auto-leave obligations. Several source defects must remain visible. No property is removed and completeness is not claimed.

assessment.methods: Static reading only, within /workspace. No tests, TLC, browsing, agents, experiment history, or source/spec edits.
assessment.expressions: Proposed predicates are specifications for later maintenance, not executable TLA+ supplied in this phase.
assessment.comparison: Old properties cannot literally consume a new record schema. Representation witnesses compare the old predicate through its stated legacy projection with the proposed predicate. Keep entries have no logical old/proposed disagreement; their concrete controls identify an edit that would be wrong.

shared_predicates.configuration: C=(I,O,L,N,A): incoming voters, outgoing voters, active learners, staged learners, AutoLeave. U(C)=I union O; Members(C)=U(C) union L. N is a subset of O, not an additional learner set. Legacy configurations embed as (voters,{},learners,{},FALSE).
shared_predicates.quorum: Majority(S,Y) iff |S intersect Y| > floor(|S|/2). JointWon(C,Y) iff I is nonempty and Majority(I,Y) and (O is empty or Majority(O,Y)). Election loss occurs if either nonempty constituent majority cannot win with remaining votes. Commit index is min(majorityIndex(I),majorityIndex(O)), with empty O contributing infinity, and commitment still requires the current-term rule.
shared_predicates.configuration_entries: IsConf(e) iff wire type is EntryConfChange or EntryConfChangeV2, including a context-only/empty V2 leave entry. Retain ordered changes, transition mode, opaque context, wire version, payload/encoded sizes, and independent request identity. Distinguish origin=Client(request), Bootstrap(peer), or AutoLeave(enter-entry,leader-term); id=0 alone is not proof of bootstrap.
shared_predicates.configuration_effect: For V1, normalize to one change and Auto transition, preserving Context; NodeID=0 is an ignored operation, not an empty V2 leave. For V2, empty Changes with Auto transition (Context ignored for classification) means LeaveJoint. Non-Auto transition or more than one change means EnterJoint; Auto and JointImplicit set A=TRUE, JointExplicit sets A=FALSE. Otherwise use Simple. An empty explicitly joint change ENTERS joint state. Only successfully applied entries change active configuration.
shared_predicates.apply_ops: Fold operations in order, atomically to external observers. Ignore NodeID=0. AddVoter adds to I and removes from L,N. AddLearner removes from I and stages in N if the ID is in O, otherwise adds to L; a staged learner remains a voter in O. Remove deletes from I,L,N and retains progress iff still in O; removing an unknown ID is idempotent. Update changes no membership. EnterJoint copies old I to O before the fold. LeaveJoint sets L'=L union N, O'=N'={}, A'=FALSE, and drops progress for IDs outside I union L'.
shared_predicates.valid_change: Simple requires O empty, nonempty resulting I, and at most one voter in the symmetric difference of old/new I. EnterJoint requires nonempty old I, empty old O, and nonempty resulting I. LeaveJoint requires nonempty O. Both input and successful output obey configuration/progress invariants. Validate independently of the source's returned error or success.
shared_predicates.configuration_provenance: ConfigAt(anchor,history,k) replays successful committed configuration callbacks from an explicitly authorized constructor/snapshot anchor. Anchors carry configuration, log index/term, and provenance. Synthetic bootstrap logs remain supported; a manually populated Storage.InitialState is not required to invent AddVoter entries. No snapshot or source post-state is used as its own independent correctness oracle.
shared_predicates.auto_leave_eligible: Current leader in a valid AutoLeave joint configuration, enter change applied, acknowledgement cursor reaches the relevant pending barrier, and no un-applied leave/other configuration entry already occupies that barrier. An automatic exit is an ordinary V2 configuration entry requiring persistence, joint commitment and application. A failed quota attempt is not an appended entry.
shared_predicates.witnesses: IDs are concrete node IDs 1,2,3,4; indexes/terms are local examples, to be embedded in suitable later bounds. Mutation witnesses need not be claimed reachable in the unmodified implementation.

Distinguish discardable peek, acceptance and completion. Node acceptance clears exactly delivered messages/read states and records SoftState; completion advances the captured batch, debits quota and records HardState. RawNode Advance combines those phases under its supported handling discipline. Peeking alone cannot acknowledge or enqueue application work.

Inflights.Clone preserves counters, capacity, ring contents and order with independent backing storage. Status includes equal BasicStatus and full copied Config; Progress is present only for a leader and is a value/deep-inflight copy. Mutating snapshots/copies never mutates live state and subsequent live mutations never mutate the saved copy. WithProgress's documented nil inflight view remains distinct.

OutcomeSoundness checks actual admission against quota, subject to the identified weight-observer repair. ReplicationEvidence requires each positive remote Match to have an acknowledged prefix; it does not confuse transport snapshot success with replication evidence or assert Next>Match.
